as is is good. short version of how to set it as wallpaper

Short version:

1. Save the image to your photos.
2. Open Settings > Wallpaper (or long-press your lock screen).
3. Choose Gallery/Photos and pick the image.
4. Set it for lock screen, then adjust the crop so the sneaker row sits in the middle.

Exact menu names vary a bit by Android version, but that's the gist.
